parent_objective: design a retargeted current-base surface refresh after M1081 found a duplicate/source-diversity dominated surface
blocked_by: M1081 found a surface but primary robustness failed on physical-pair diversity, success-drop fraction, and pair dominance
invalidates: converting the M1081 surface directly into replay/objective corpora
loosening M1081 robustness gates after failure

public_gates: M1082 must not mine rows; design only
M1082 must not use private holdout
M1082 must address physical-pair diversity and success-drop fraction explicitly
forbidden_shortcuts: do not lower source-diversity or success-drop thresholds

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: pre-registers a retargeted sampling/boundary plan after M1081 duplicate-dominated failure
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no mining, no training, no promotion, no private holdout
stop_condition: stop if design lowers robustness thresholds
stop if design does not increase physical-pair/source diversity
stop if design does not improve success-drop filtering pressure
fallback_plan: if design is accepted, run retargeted refresh in M1083
if design is inadequate, route to tooling audit for success-drop-filtered boundary relocation
if repeated retargeting fails, synthesize branch and pivot away from surface refresh
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1081 failed primary robustness as duplicate/source-diversity dominated

hypothesis: A retargeted refresh with more probe sources, stricter source caps, and boundary relocation offsets can recover a source-diverse all-success-drop surface without weakening robustness thresholds.
success_criteria: no training, PPO, mining, promotion, or private holdout occurs
decision_rule: M1082 may only design a retargeted refresh. It cannot train, run PPO, mine rows, promote, use private holdout, or weaken M1081 acceptance thresholds.
